recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: railways scanning the countryside like a flatbed
forgotten printers waking with drivers written by machines
karl-the-fog rolling through a summer night in san francisco
agents spawning from a phone shortcut at dawn

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a cable car through thick Karl-the-Fog — swipe between vanishing lanes to catch neon street signs before they dissolve into gray.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each clear glimpse adds a fragment to a postcard you're assembling in 30 seconds.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog thickens, lanes narrow, and signs blink faster as wind picks up.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor SF hills with soft neon accents

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag a scanner beam along a miniature railway route — capture passing landscape textures into a mosaic before the track runs out.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Completing a scan reveals a hidden landmark silhouette at the end of the line.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Train speeds up, curves tighten, and rare textures appear only for a heartbeat.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: cyan wireframe tracks on warm parchment

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort scrambled printer driver fragments by tapping them into the correct stack before an obsolete HP spits out a garbled page.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Each perfect stack prints one crisp line of a mysterious poem.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Fragments multiply and stacks shuffle mid-round as the printer overheats.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: beige CRT office glow with dot-matrix streaks

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap in rhythm as agent shortcuts fire from your phone — match the pulse of GitHub Actions triggers spawning parallel bots on screen.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Chaining perfect beats launches a tiny ship animation that clears the terminal clutter.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: BPM climbs, ghost notes appear, and agent windows multiply across the display.
